{
  "dataset_name": "car_evaluation",
  "model_family": "distance_knn",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "buying_z",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Scale-normalized buying price (z-score) for distance computation.",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 2.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Equalizes feature scale so KNN distance is not dominated by raw integer encoding.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(buying - 1.4382239382239381) / 1.148713537637001"
    },
    {
      "name": "maint_z",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Scale-normalized maintenance cost (z-score).",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 2.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Balances contribution of maintenance dimension in Euclidean distance.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(maint - 1.4034749034749034) / 1.1051596655849332"
    },
    {
      "name": "safety_z",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Scale-normalized safety rating (z-score).",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 2.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalizes safety axis to comparable variance for neighborhood geometry.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(safety - 0.9922779922779923) / 0.8101302530873647"
    },
    {
      "name": "persons_z",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Scale-normalized passenger capacity (z-score).",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 2.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Prevents persons dimension underweighting in distance metric.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(persons - 1.0366795366795367) / 0.8105280808769877"
    },
    {
      "name": "cost_pressure",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Combined buying + maintenance cost burden.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a cost-axis similarity dimension that groups financially similar cars.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "buying + maint"
    },
    {
      "name": "utility_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Combined practical utility score from persons, lug_boot, and safety.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Groups rows with similar usability profile for nearest-neighbor lookup.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "persons + lug_boot + safety"
    },
    {
      "name": "dist_to_low_safety_prototype",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Euclidean distance to a generic low-safety, low-capacity prototype (origin reference point).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Anchors rows to a reference geometry to enhance neighbor discrimination.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(persons**2 + safety**2 + lug_boot**2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "dist_to_premium_prototype",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Euclidean distance to a generic premium-feature prototype (max values across attributes).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a complementary anchor improving radial neighborhood structure.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt((3 - buying)**2 + (3 - maint)**2 + (2 - safety)**2 + (2 - persons)**2 + (2 - lug_boot)**2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "safety_persons_synergy",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Multiplicative interaction capturing usable-capacity coupled with safety.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures non-linear coupling that improves KNN local separability.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "safety * persons"
    },
    {
      "name": "is_unusable_cluster",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Cluster indicator for rows where persons=0 or safety=0 (structurally unusable cars).",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a hard geometric partition aiding neighbor purity.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((persons == 0) | (safety == 0), 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "cost_utility_gap",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Difference between cost burden and utility score, indicating value imbalance.",
      "value_range": [-6.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds a signed axis along which similar value-propositions cluster.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(buying + maint) - (persons + lug_boot + safety)"
    },
    {
      "name": "overall_quality_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Heuristic ordinal quality judgment combining safety dominance, capacity adequacy, and affordability into a 0-4 scale, where higher means a more attractive car profile based purely on row attributes without supervised information.",
      "value_range": [0, 4],
      "feature_family": "semantic_judgment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a coarse semantic axis along which neighbors with similar overall desirability cluster, improving KNN locality.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
